subject: indiv-td
title: (R)INDIV.TD.------COS.P.
description: Chart on book p. 111 (ALT(FT)II-5). INDIV-TD (individual tendencies) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; COS-P (cosmic particulars) is the partner. From the subject: C-INFO (composite information) and AFL (affinity alignment). From C-INFO: C-CONT (composite continuance). From C-CONT: SOC-RT (social reality). From SOC-RT: CUL-INFO-DY. From AFL: AFL-DY (affinity dynamics). From AFL-DY: INFO-AF-B (information affinity basis).
